post.caption:
Nothing in orbit slows down, because there is no air to bleed the speed off, so every spent stage, dead satellite and paint fleck is still travelling around 28,000 km/h. At that speed mass barely matters and a metal chip punches through a pressure hull. Worse, collisions multiply: two objects become a thousand, each able to hit something else, which is Kessler syndrome. Anti-satellite tests added to it deliberately. The useful orbits are finite and nobody can enforce anything.
